title: Cape to Cairo
story: Cecil Rhodes dreamed of a railway from the Cape to Cairo through British territory; it was never completed.

title: The Pan-American Highway
story: The highway runs from Alaska to the far south of Argentina, broken only by the roadless Darién Gap between Panama and Colombia.

title: The Silk Road
story: For over a thousand years, caravans carried silk, spices and ideas overland between China and the Mediterranean.

title: Following the Danube
story: Europe's second-longest river flows through or along the borders of ten countries, more than any other river in the world.

title: Down the Mekong
story: Rising on the Tibetan Plateau, the Mekong flows through six countries to its delta in southern Vietnam.

title: The spine of the Andes
story: The world's longest continental mountain range runs about 7,000 km down the western side of South America.

title: Across the Sahel
story: The Sahel is the semi-arid belt between the Sahara and the savanna, stretching from the Atlantic to the Red Sea.

title: From Iberia to Istanbul
story: A road trip around the northern Mediterranean, through the Balkans to the city that was once Byzantium and Constantinople.

title: Lisbon to Moscow
story: Napoleon marched the last stretch of this road in 1812; only a fraction of his Grande Armée came back.
